name: chrome_search_wikipedia_opened_date
intent: Search Wikipedia in Chrome for an article and report when it opened
description: Using Chrome, navigate to the mobile Wikipedia site, search for a requested topic, open its article, and find the date or year it opened.
patterns: search Wikipedia and tell me when it opened
look up a place on Wikipedia and find its opening year
when did it open according to Wikipedia
find the opening date on Wikipedia

inputs.name: article_topic
inputs.description: The topic or article to search for on Wikipedia.

steps.intent: Go back to dismiss the current selection and prepare to enter a URL
Tap Search to open the search or address field
Type en.m.wikipedia.org into the address bar to go to mobile Wikipedia
Tap Search to open the Wikipedia search box
Type {{article_topic}} into the search box to search for the article
Scroll down the {{article_topic}} article to find when it opened
